title: Addressing Corpus Knowledge Poisoning Attacks on RAG Using Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2602.04711v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is a highly effective paradigm for keeping LLM-based responses up-to-date and reducing the likelihood of hallucinations. Yet, RAG was recently shown to be quite vulnerable to corpus knowledge poisoning: an attacker injects misleading documents to the corpus to steer an LLM's output to an undesired response. We argue that the standard causal attention mechanism in LLMs enables harmful cross-document interactions, specifically in cases of attacks. Accordingly, we introduce a novel defense approach for RAG: Sparse Document Attention RAG (SDAG). This is a block-sparse attention mechanism that disallows cross-attention between retrieved documents. SDAG requires a minimal inference-time change to the attention mask. We present an empirical evaluation of LLM-based question answering (QA) with a variety of attack strategies on RAG. We show that our SDAG method substantially outperforms the standard causal

translated_title: 利用稀疏注意力应对RAG中的语料库知识投毒攻击
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）是一种非常有效的范式，用于保持基于LLM的响应最新并减少幻觉的可能性。然而，最近研究表明RAG容易受到语料库知识投毒攻击：攻击者向语料库中注入误导性文档，以将LLM的输出引导至不期望的响应。我们认为，LLM中的标准因果注意力机制在攻击情况下会促成有害的跨文档交互。因此，我们提出了一种新颖的RAG防御方法：稀疏文档注意力RAG（SDAG）。这是一种块稀疏注意力机制，禁止检索文档之间的交叉注意力。SDAG需要对注意力掩码进行最小推理时修改。我们通过多种攻击策略对基于LLM的问答（QA）进行了实证评估。结果表明，我们的SDAG方法显著优于标准因果方法。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于稀疏注意力机制的RAG防御方法（SDAG），通过禁止检索文档间的交叉注意力来有效抵御语料库知识投毒攻击。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sparse attention-based RAG defense method (SDAG) that blocks cross-attention between retrieved documents to effectively counter corpus knowledge poisoning attacks.
